title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Whisk eggs and parmesan in a bowl.
Mix hot pasta with bacon, then remove from heat.
Quickly stir in egg-cheese mixture to create a creamy sauce.
Season with black pepper and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Grilled chicken cooked in a creamy tomato-based sauce with spices.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear chicken until cooked.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Simmer 5 minutes and serve with rice.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Quick and healthy toast topped with mashed avocado and lemon.
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Top with chili flakes if desired.
